about: A/B benchmark (Definition of Done). A = Claude Code alone with the raw request. B = Baguette (grill answered with the recommended options, brief, routing, verification, one automatic fix; Question mode for questions; "Continue this task" for follow-ups, where A resumes its own session). Hidden checks are never shown to A or B.

tasks.request: Create a showcase website for my bakery "Au Bon Pain" in Lyon: an introduction, the opening hours (Tuesday to Sunday, 7am to 7pm), three signature products and a contact form. The site must be in English and display well on phones.
In this project, add an exported function done(todos, id) and a command `node todo.js done <id>` that marks a task as done. format() must show done tasks with "[x]". Add tests.
My clients complain: the total including tax on my invoices is off by a few cents when there are several lines. Fix it.
Make me a website for my bakery Au Bon Pain, in Lyon.

Add a command `node todo.js export <file.csv>` that exports the tasks as CSV (columns id,text,done) and an exported function toCsv(todos). Task text can contain commas, quotes and line breaks: the CSV must stay valid.
Where does this app save the todos, and how can I make it use another file?
Add a `node todo.js rename <id> <text>` command and an exported function rename(todos, id, text), with tests.
tasks.follow_up: Now do the same for priorities: a `node todo.js priority <id> <high|low>` command and an exported function setPriority(todos, id, level), tested the same way. format() must show high-priority todos with a leading "!".
